subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate coverage as sufficient proof for this xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content retry fix?
rationale: The contributor credibly explains that the exact code-less xAI stale-blob error requires a provider snapshot/key rotation and cannot be forced on demand, but ClawSweeper's normal external-PR gate still requires after-fix real behavior proof or an explicit maintainer override.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Treat the pre-fix production logs, current source reproduction, existing retry-path history, and focused tests as sufficient for this provider-side trigger, then require exact-head CI/rebase checks before merge.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR open until another xAI stale-blob rotation occurs and the contributor can attach redacted patched-gateway recovery logs.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Do not proceed until maintainers decide whether the proof gap is acceptable for a P1 provider-runtime outage fix.
